mission.title: Entrepreneurs Club is Northeastern's Largest Student-led Organization.
mission.body: We have 4 programs, 2,000+ active members, and over 30 events each semester. We connect students with resources and speakers—including venture capitalists, industry leaders, and co-founders—to explore career paths and foster an entrepreneurial mindset.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.lede: Five ways to get involved, from your first idea to your first cap table.
